title: Anansi and the Sky God's Stories

game.start: Help Anansi climb his shimmering silver web to the clouds! Tap the three silver web-rungs from bottom to top.
game.praise: Up and up! Clever Anansi climbs high toward the fluffy morning clouds!

game.start: Accept Sky God Nyame's task with Anansi! Tap all four golden banners around the cloud court.
game.praise: Four bright golden banners! Brave little Anansi is ready for his big quest!

game.start: Help pack! Match the bamboo pole to Anansi, the vine cord to Aso, and the gourd to the woven bag.
game.praise: All packed and ready! Wise Aso and clever Anansi make a marvellous team!

game.start: Help Anansi tie proud Onini snugly to the bamboo pole! Tap the three soft vine loops from tail to nose.
game.praise: Snug and gentle! Three soft vine loops hold proud Onini safely on the bamboo pole!

spreads.title: A Dry Gourd for the Hornets

game.start: Guide the buzzing Mmoboro hornets out of the rain! Tap all four hornets to send them into the dry gourd.
game.praise: Safe and dry! Every buzzing hornet hums happily inside the cosy calabash gourd!

game.start: Weave a strong silver web hammock to lift Osebo gently up! Tap when the ring glows green!
game.praise: Three strong silver weaves! The shimmering silk hammock glows bright and ready to lift Osebo!

game.start: Pack the gifts! Match sweet yams to the bowl, the doll to the basket, and the drum to Anansi.
game.praise: Everything is ready! Sweet golden yams, a smiling doll, and a joyful little drum!

game.start: Play a gentle welcome beat on the little drum! Tap three times when the ring glows green.
game.praise: Three sweet drumbeats! Warm golden music sparkles beside the wiggling green fern!

game.start: Wake the Golden Story Box with Sky God Nyame's blessing! Tap all four golden star-seals to light them.
game.praise: Shining gold! All four star-seals sparkle around the gleaming Golden Story Box!

game.start: Share the tales! Match the python scroll to Aso, leopard scroll to the boy, and fairy scroll to the girl.
game.praise: Wonderful sharing! Laughter and warm magic fill the lantern-lit Ashanti courtyard!
